page.overview:
What is Azurill?

Azurill appears to be a small blue mouse with a round water balloon attached to the end of its tail. Its balloon tail is blue and is used to bounce higher. It also has small ears and small feet. On its face, there are two white circles, giving an impression of blush. It can use its tail to bounce around.

The ball is bouncy and packed with the nutrients it needs to be able to grow. The ball can also be used as a flotation device. It can be seen bouncing and playing on this rubbery tail. The tail can also be spun around like a lasso. When the tail is thrown, the body can go as far as 33 feet (10 meters). Though Azurill is typically docile, it swings the big ball on its tail to smash into opponents bigger than itself when angered.

It lives at the water's edge, where they gather to splash around for fun on sunny days.

Azurill can fling itself more than ten yards by spinning the large ball at the end of its tail and then throwing it.
